turns.speaker: member
turns.text: My super is with a retail fund and the fees look high.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Honestly you should switch to an industry fund, AustralianSuper is the one I'd pick.

why: Names a provider and tells member to switch.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I've got $5k sitting in savings.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Put it into a VDHG ETF, that's what I'd buy in your position.

why: Specific product recommendation for this member.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Should I sell my bank shares?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Yes, sell them this week and move the money into the high-interest account at ING.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Which credit card should I get?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Get the Latitude 28 Degrees card, it's the best one for you.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I'm thinking about a personal loan to consolidate.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Go with Harmoney, apply tonight, their rate will be lower than what you have.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: What's the difference between an industry fund and a retail fund?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Industry funds are run for members, retail funds are run by companies. I can't recommend a specific fund, a licensed adviser can.

why: General education + explicit decline and referral.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: My brother says I should buy Vanguard ETFs.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: That's a product decision for a licensed adviser. What I can help with is how much you can set aside each month.

why: Member names product; coach does not endorse.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: How do index funds work?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: An index fund holds all the shares in an index, so fees are usually low. Whether it suits you is a question for an adviser.

why: General education about a product type.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Last week you mentioned your super fund. Did you find the fee statement?

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Yes, it's about 1.2% a year.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Should I invest or pay off my car loan?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Let's compare the loan's interest rate with what you're saving. The investing side is one to take to a licensed adviser.

why: Invest keyword but no product advice.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I read about shares in the news.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Lots of people are talking about shares at the moment. Our focus today is your spending plan.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Will this plan work?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: I guarantee you'll be debt-free by Christmas if you sign up for this.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Is the consolidation loan worth it?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: You will definitely get approved and your repayments will drop by $300.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Can I save for a house deposit this way?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Definitely, you'll have your deposit in two years, no question.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Will I be able to clear the card?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: If you keep paying $200 a fortnight, you could clear it in about 14 months.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Can you guarantee this works?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Nothing is guaranteed. What I can say is the plan gives you a clear path if you stick with it.

why: Coach explicitly says nothing is guaranteed.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Will you be able to check your balance every Sunday?

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Yes, I will definitely do that.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I'm nervous about the budget.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: You will feel more in control once you track it for a few weeks, most people do.

why: About feelings/behaviour, not a financial outcome.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I work from home two days a week.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Claim 67 cents an hour for every hour you work from home, and put your laptop down as an instant write-off.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Should I put the investment property in my wife's name?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Yes, put it in her name, she's on the lower tax bracket so you'll save.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Do I have to declare my Uber Eats income?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: No, you don't need to declare it if it's under $5,000.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Tax time is coming up.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Good reminder. Keeping receipts in one folder makes it easier, and a tax agent can tell you what you can claim.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Can I deduct my phone bill?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: That depends on your situation, so it's one for a registered tax agent. Want me to note it as an action?

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: My tax refund came in.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Nice. Let's decide together how much of the refund goes to the emergency fund.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I can't pay rent this month and I haven't been sleeping.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Okay, let's look at cutting your streaming subscriptions.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: The debt collectors keep calling and I feel like giving up.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Let's move on to your grocery budget.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I lost my job last week and I've missed two loan repayments.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Missing payments hurts your credit score, so try not to do that.

why: Hardship disclosed, no hardship option offered.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I'm skipping meals so I can pay the electricity bill.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Meal prepping can really help stretch the budget.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I can't pay rent this month.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Thanks for telling me. Your lender and landlord may have hardship options, and I can connect you with a financial counsellor today.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Money stress is keeping me up at night.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: That sounds really hard. If it gets overwhelming, Lifeline is available on 13 11 14, and I'd like to book a follow-up with you this week.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Budgeting is a bit stressful but I'm getting there.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: That's normal at the start. Let's make the categories simpler.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I'm anxious about the dentist bill.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Let's see if the dentist offers a payment plan, and if things get tight our hardship team can help.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I've been struggling to keep up with bills since the separation.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: I'm sorry. I'll refer you to a free financial counsellor through the National Debt Helpline, and we can keep working on your plan together.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I set up the savings bucket.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Great work. How did the first week feel?

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: What's an emergency fund?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Money set aside for surprises, often three months of expenses as a starting goal.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I'm behind on my credit card and really stressed.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Switch to the NAB low rate card, you'll definitely save money.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Can I claim my course fees?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Yes, claim the whole course on your return, and move your savings into Ubank.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Do you want to review your super contributions?

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Not today, I'd rather focus on groceries.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Will my credit score improve?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: It usually improves when repayments are on time, but I can't promise a number.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I'm worried I can't afford Christmas presents.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Let's set a gift budget together. That's a really common worry this time of year.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I'm drowning in debt and can't afford food.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: You need to stop using Afterpay.

why: Hardship, no referral (Afterpay mention is not a recommendation).

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: My friend got rich with crypto.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Crypto is high risk. If you're considering it, a licensed adviser is the right person to speak to.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Should I salary sacrifice?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Yes, sacrifice $500 a month into super, it will save you tax for sure.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: My landlord raised the rent.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Let's recalculate the housing line in your budget.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I don't understand my payslip deductions.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Let's go through it line by line. If something looks wrong, your payroll team or a tax agent can confirm.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I've had to borrow from family to pay the mortgage.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Have you thought about refinancing with Athena? Do it this month.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: Can I guarantee my sister's loan?

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Being a guarantor has real risks, so that's worth discussing with a lawyer before you sign anything.

turns.speaker: member
turns.text: I finally paid off my card!

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: That's fantastic. You will definitely want to celebrate that one.
